summary: Iteration 2 verified the multi-tier update. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass — new /api/gallery/taxonomy shape (RESIDENTIAL / COMMERCIAL + correct subs), new POST /api/admin/upload (auth-gated, MIME-checked, 12MB cap) returns {url, filename, size} with /api/uploads/... URL that is publicly fetchable via the StaticFiles mount, gallery CRUD works with the new category/subcategory schema. Frontend: hero shows 24 slides (all real), headline computed 88px at 1440px (clamp(2.4rem,6.5vw,5.5rem)), active slide advances every ~3s. Both nav dropdowns render on the cream panel with DARK text (rgb(31,26,22)) even while header is over the dark hero. Divisions section renders exactly 'INTERIORS' and 'RENOVATIONS / RESTORATIONS' with lh3.googleusercontent.com Drive URLs. /gallery renders 2 tabs (RESIDENTIAL, COMMERCIAL), 6 residential subs and 3 commercial subs match exactly, filtering by Bedrooms yields Bedrooms-only cards. /works regression: Residential ≥40 cards, Hospitality shows the 3 Baked in Bombay cards. CRITICAL FRONTEND WIRING BUG FOUND: /admin route still mounts the legacy AdminDashboardPage.jsx (not the new AdminGallery.jsx), so the required admin-file-upload-input testid does NOT exist and clicking '+ New Photo' throws a runtime error because the legacy code reads taxonomy.spaces[0]/segments[0] which no longer exist in the new taxonomy shape.

ui_bugs.issue: Legacy component still mounted at /admin — clicking '+ New Photo' throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 0)' in emptyPhoto() because it references taxonomy.spaces[0]/segments[0] from the OLD schema. New AdminGallery.jsx (with data-testid=admin-file-upload-input and RESIDENTIAL/COMMERCIAL support) is never imported by App.js.
Button label reads '+ New Photo' (should be '+ Add Photograph' per new AdminGallery.jsx). Confirms old component is mounted.

References stale taxonomy.spaces / taxonomy.segments and photo.space / photo.segment fields. All admin-side gallery editing is broken until this file is replaced by AdminGallery.jsx or refactored to category/subcategory.

rca of the issue: AdminGallery.jsx (new 2-tier + upload component) was added under src/components/admin/ but App.js still routes /admin to the legacy AdminDashboardPage.jsx. Legacy code calls taxonomy.spaces[0] / taxonomy.segments[0] which are undefined in the new taxonomy shape ({categories, subcategories}), producing the runtime TypeError on '+ New Photo' click. Fix: wire AdminGallery.jsx into the Gallery tab of AdminDashboardPage (or replace the inline gallery section with <AdminGallery/>).
